BiblicalUsage: Malmad is the ox goad, and it appears once, in Judges 3:31, where Shamgar the son of Anath slew six hundred Philistines with an ox goad, and he also delivered Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the goad is the whole lesson of Shamgar: God does not need a sword, He needs a man willing to use what is in his hand.
